name: Mind Strike (Mythic)
body:
Your sneak attacks leave your target bewildered for a long time.

Prerequisite(s): Mind Strike.

Benefit(s): Whenever you deal sneak attack damage, the penalty on your target’s Will saves lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1 + ½ your mythic tier (minimum +1). Each time you deal sneak attack damage to an affected target, the duration stacks.
